# UIL library sources
set(UIL_LIB_SRCS
    UilCmd.c
    UilDiags.c
    UilKeyTab.c
    UilLexAna.c
    UilLstLst.c
    UilP2Out.c
    UilP2Reslv.c
    UilSarComp.c
    UilSarExp.c
    UilSarInc.c
    UilSarMod.c
    UilSarObj.c
    UilSarProc.c
    UilSarVal.c
    UilSrcSrc.c
    UilSymNam.c
    UilSymStor.c
    UilData.c
    UilLstMac.c
    UilSemVal.c
    UilSemCSet.c
    UilDB.c
)

# UIL parser files are generated by WML tools
set(UIL_PARSER_C ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib/Uil/Uil.c)
set(UIL_PARSER_H ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib/Uil/Uil.h)

list(APPEND UIL_LIB_SRCS ${UIL_PARSER_C} ${UIL_PARSER_H})

# Generate message catalog header file
if(WITH_MESSAGE_CATALOG)
    motif_add_message_catalog(uil_msgcat_header Uil
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Uil.msg
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h
    )
else()
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "/* UilMsgCatI.h - Generated stub */" > ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "#ifndef _UilMsgCatI_h" >> ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "#define _UilMsgCatI_h" >> ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "#endif /* _UilMsgCatI_h */" >> ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h
        COMMENT "Creating Uil message catalog stub"
    )
    add_custom_target(uil_msgcat_header ALL DEPENDS ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil/UilMsgCatI.h)
endif()

# Generate the UIL parser from Uil.y.  The sources include its header as
# "UilLexPars.h", so provide a copy under that name.  Everything is written to
# the build tree; bison and byacc both accept -d -o.
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Uil.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Uil.h
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/UilLexPars.h
    COMMAND ${MOTIF_YACC_EXECUTABLE} -d -o Uil.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Uil.y
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy Uil.h UilLexPars.h
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Uil.y
    COMMENT "Generating the UIL parser from Uil.y"
    VERBATIM
)
set(BISON_uil_OUTPUTS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Uil.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Uil.h
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/UilLexPars.h
)

# Create a target for the UIL parser generation
add_custom_target(uil_parser_target
    DEPENDS ${BISON_uil_OUTPUTS}
    COMMENT "UIL parser generation target"
)

# The compiler proper, shared by libUil and the uil program (as upstream
# builds both from the same sources).  It is compiled once, as PIC so that it
# can go into the shared library.
add_library(UilCompiler OBJECT ${UIL_LIB_SRCS})
set_target_properties(UilCompiler PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# Ensure the message catalog header, the WML tables and the parser are
# generated before building the compiler
add_dependencies(UilCompiler uil_msgcat_header wml_generated_files uil_parser_target)

# Include directories and definitions of the compiler, for UilCompiler,
# libUil and uil
function(motif_uil_compiler_setup target)
    target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lib
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lib/Uil
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/bin/uil
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/bin/wml
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include/uil
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib/Uil
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/bin/uil
        ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/bin/wml
    )
    # Run-time search paths, compiled in as absolute paths
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE
        INCDIR="${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_INCLUDEDIR}/X11"
        LIBDIR="${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_LIBDIR}/X11"
    )
    if(WITH_UIL_DEBUG)
        target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE XM_UIL_DEBUG)
    endif()
endfunction()
motif_uil_compiler_setup(UilCompiler)
target_link_libraries(UilCompiler PRIVATE Mrm Xm)

# Create libUil library (shared, like libXm and libMrm, as upstream ships it).
# UilMain.c built with CALLABLE provides the Uil() entry point and the
# uil_exit() and uil_catd that the compiler uses, in place of main().
add_library(Uil ${MOTIF_LIB_TYPE}
    $<TARGET_OBJECTS:UilCompiler>
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/bin/uil/UilMain.c
)
set_target_properties(Uil PROPERTIES
    VERSION ${MOTIF_LIBRARY_VERSION}
    SOVERSION ${MOTIF_SOVERSION}
)
add_library(Motif::Uil ALIAS Uil)

# Export only the symbols of libUil.map (see doc/abi-policy.md)
motif_version_script(Uil ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libUil.map)

add_dependencies(Uil UilCompiler)
motif_uil_compiler_setup(Uil)
target_compile_definitions(Uil PRIVATE CALLABLE)

target_link_libraries(Uil
    PUBLIC
        Mrm
        Xm
    PRIVATE
        m
)

# Install library
install(TARGETS Uil
    EXPORT MotifTargets
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
)

# Install headers
install(FILES
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib/Uil/Uil.h
    UilSymGl.h
    UilSymDef.h
    UilDef.h
    UilAPI.h
    UilDBDef.h
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/uil
)

# abi.exports.Uil: libUil.map must list what the installed headers declare.
# Uil.h, the header of the generated parser, is left out: of what it
# declares only the token values are for use outside the compiler.
motif_exports_test(Uil ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libUil.map
    HEADERS UilSymGl.h UilSymDef.h UilDef.h UilAPI.h UilDBDef.h
    OBJECTS_OF UilCompiler
)
